_source.title: 关闭 WebSocket 连接
_source.remarks.text.0: 注意：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.code: 数字状态码，对应 {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/CloseEvent/code | WebSocket.CloseEvent} 内允许的状态码
_source.params.reason: 一个人类可读的字符串，解释连接关闭的原因
_source.params.extensionUuid: 扩展 UUID，一般不需要指定，仅当需要操作其它扩展建立的 WebSocket 连接时才需要指定为其它扩展的 UUID

title: Close the WebSocket connection
remarks.text.0: Note: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
params.code: Numeric status code, corresponding to the codes allowed in {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/CloseEvent/code | WebSocket.CloseEvent}
params.reason: A human-readable string explaining why the connection was closed
params.extensionUuid: Extension UUID. Generally it does not need to be specified. It only needs to be specified as another extension's UUID when you need to operate on a WebSocket connection established by another extension
